task_title: typed as-of-git-unavailable refusal when git is absent
task_criteria: A missing git binary reaches the user as a typed 'spec error (as-of-git-unavailable)' refusal with exit 2 and zero traceback frames from spec check AND spec validate; both verbs agree; the code exists in docs/VERBS.md; a regression test test_spec_missing_git is gate-listed; with git present behaviour is unchanged.

items.criterion: A missing git binary reaches the user as a typed 'spec error (as-of-git-unavailable)' refusal with exit 2 and zero traceback frames from spec check AND spec validate; both verbs agree; the code exists in docs/VERBS.md; a regression test test_spec_missing_git is gate-listed; with git present behaviour is unchanged.
items.detail: Live probe with git hidden (`env PATH=<empty tmpdir> .venv/bin/python auger.py spec check tests/fixtures/xml/verification`): rc=2, stdout 0 bytes, stderr exactly `spec error (as-of-git-unavailable): the git executable is not available; auger reads repository history and repository roots through git`, `grep -c '^  File '` = 0; `spec validate` byte-identical, and both also rc=2/0 frames with `--repo-root .`. Code path: auger.py:13482 `_git_toplevel` routes through `_spec_git_run` (auger.py:13492-13506) which converts FileNotFoundError into SpecError("as-of-git-unavailable"); cmd_spec (auger.py:12968-12971) prints `spec error (<code>)` and raises SystemExit(2). Both verbs agree per tests/test_spec_missing_git.py:63-70 and identical live stderr. docs/VERBS.md:784-787 documents the code for validate/check/bundle (also line 673). tests/gate.sh:273 pytest argv lists tests/test_spec_missing_git.py, which defines test_spec_missing_git_check_refuses_typed (line 43), _validate_refuses_typed (53), _both_verbs_agree (63); `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_spec_missing_git.py -v` => `3 passed in 0.79s` exit_code 0. Git-present behaviour unchanged: `spec validate tests/fixtures/xml/verification` rc=0 `spec: 1 document(s), 2 block(s), 1 reference(s) ok`; `spec check` rc=0 `{"nodes": ["REQ-MIG-1", "TEST-MIG-1"], "rollback": {}, "status": "valid"}`; `spec validate specs` rc=0. Full gate run by me: `DUCKBRAIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bash tests/gate.sh` => `931 passed, 4 skipped in 911.56s (0:15:11)`, `pytest lock-attributed skips: 0`, ending `== docs check ==` / `LIVE ARMS: ran 2; skipped 0` / `GATE PASS`, `grep -cE 'GATE FAIL|failed,'` = 0. Pre-fix falsifier: c9c01a3 auger.py under the same empty PATH yields rc=1 with 10 traceback frames ending `FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'git'` for both verbs, so the regression test genuinely discriminates.

items.criterion: Reachability/seam: the missing-git refusal must be raised at the single git-subprocess seam (_spec_git_run) and caught by the cmd_spec SpecError handler so BOTH spec check and spec validate render it, including when --repo-root is passed explicitly (which still calls _git_toplevel).
items.detail: auger.py:13482 calls `_spec_git_run(["git","-C",...,"rev-parse","--show-toplevel"])`; _spec_git_run (auger.py:13492-13506) is the only place FileNotFoundError is translated, and cmd_spec's `except SpecError` (auger.py:12968-12971) renders it with SystemExit(2). The explicit `--repo-root` branch of `_spec_repository_root` also calls `_git_toplevel` (auger.py:13609), and the now-dead `except FileNotFoundError: pass` in `_spec_corpus_as_of` was removed (auger.py:13520-13523). Verified live: `spec check|validate ... --repo-root .` with empty PATH both rc=2, 0 traceback frames, same typed line; additionally `spec bundle`, `spec list specs --as-of HEAD` and `spec check --diff-file /dev/null` (the align path) all refuse rc=2 with 0 frames.

items.criterion: Back-compat: with git present, spec check/validate output and exit codes are unchanged, and the pre-existing spec suites (as-of, repository-root, validators-agree, obligations, node-list) stay green.
items.detail: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py tests/test_spec_repository_root.py tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py tests/test_spec_validate_obligations.py tests/test_spec_check_node_list.py -q` => `60 passed in 19.92s` exit_code 0; `tests/test_spec_as_of.py tests/test_spec_missing_git.py` together => `14 passed in 7.52s`. With git present the verbs print their pre-change payloads (`spec: 1 document(s), 2 block(s), 1 reference(s) ok`, rc=0; check JSON `status: valid`, rc=0). The only behavioural delta with git present is the generalized refusal detail string in `_spec_git_run`, which no git-present path reaches. Full gate: `931 passed, 4 skipped` / `GATE PASS`.
